matches.name: Stream'.coinduction
matches.signature:
theorem coinduction {s₁ s₂ : Stream' α} :
    head s₁ = head s₂ →
      (∀ (β : Type u) (fr : Stream' α → β),
      fr s₁ = fr s₂ → fr (tail s₁) = fr (tail s₂)) → s₁ = s₂

matches.name: Cslib.LTS.HomBisimilarity
matches.docstring: Homogeneous bisimilarity is bisimilarity where the underlying LTSs are the same.

matches.name: QPF.Cofix.bisim_rel
matches.signature:
theorem Cofix.bisim_rel (r : Cofix F → Cofix F → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, r x y → Quot.mk r <$> Cofix.dest x = Quot.mk r <$> Cofix.dest y) :
    ∀ x y, r x y → x = y

matches.name: QPF.Cofix.bisim'
matches.signature:
theorem Cofix.bisim' {α : Type*} (Q : α → Prop) (u v : α → Cofix F)
    (h : ∀ x, Q x → ∃ a f f', Cofix.dest (u x) = abs ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ Cofix.dest (v x) = abs ⟨a, f'⟩ ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ x', Q x' ∧ f i = u x' ∧ f' i = v x') :
    ∀ x, Q x → u x = v x
